findings: BullMQ job.updateProgress() is called with incremental values (10, 30, 50, 85, 95) from the Python engine.
However, these updates are only pushed to Redis (BullMQ). The PostgreSQL database (AnalysisJob.progress) is NOT updated during the run.
The AnalysisProcessor only updates the DB at the start (status=RUNNING, progress=5) and at the end (status=COMPLETED, progress=100).
required_fix: Modify AnalysisProcessor.ts to call this.updateJobStatus(job.data.jobId, 'RUNNING', undefined, statusData.progress) during the polling loop so the DB reflects real-time progress.
